item.title: SuperDucky Product Overview
item.description: SuperDucky is a desktop mod manager for PC games. Keep dozens of mods under control, save every version of each mod, drag to set and preview the load order, switch whole setups with profiles, and manage Steam Workshop subscriptions and dependencies. It supports Escape from Duckov, Probably Stolen and The Binding of Isaac.
